title.en: Parks and Trees (Composition of Offences) Regulations

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Parks and Trees (Composition of Offences) Regulations.
2. All offences under the Parks and Trees Regulations (Rg 1) may be compounded by the Commissioner in accordance with section 51(1) of the Act.

heading.en: Manner of payment of composition amounts

text.en:
3. All composition amounts shall be payable to the Board and may be paid —
(a)by money order, postal order or cheque drawn on any bank in Singapore delivered or sent by post to the Board’s office;
(b)by any electronic means as the Board may permit from time to time, subject to such terms and conditions as the Board may impose in connection with the use of such means; or
(c)in such other manner as the Board may, from time to time, authorise in any particular case or class of cases.
[G.N. No. S 520/2005]
